paragraphs.text: CISA added four actively exploited flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog while critical vulnerabilities in OpenSSH, SAP NetWeaver, Barracuda Email Security Gateway, and Microsoft Exchange face active exploitation by criminal and state-sponsored actors. These developments elevate remediation urgency for vulnerability management programs and demand verification of third-party security appliance integrity. Control owners must confirm asset coverage for listed products and validate emergency patching completion.

A nation-state attack on refrigeration controllers at hundreds of retail sites demonstrates operational technology targeting with physical consequences, while Turla's Cereal malware enables persistent email collection from government Exchange servers. These incidents extend accountability to industrial control system suppliers and email platform administrators. Owners should review OT network segmentation and Exchange compromise detection capabilities.
